source_of_field_names: PeerComps public descriptions (peercomps.com, gvalue.com, valuationproducts.com) parsed 2026-09-28; delivered as PDF reports
notes: PeerComps sources SBA-lender transactions (16,000+, ~100/month added since 1999). Overlaps conceptually with our SBA loan-proxy comps but PeerComps carries the ACTUAL sale price plus normalized financials, so price_basis = actual, not loan_proxy.
Delivered as PDF comp reports, not a clean CSV/API export. Ingest likely needs PDF parsing or a manual/exported data pull; confirm the actual delivery format before building the parser.
Reports price to revenue, price to SDE, and price to EBITDA multiples.
Field labels below are INFERRED from public descriptions; no real export/PDF was parsed for exact headers, so most are verified=false pending a real sample.

ar_ap_normalization.detail: VERIFIED from public descriptions: PeerComps Price includes normal fixed assets, normal inventory, and goodwill, but EXCLUDES accounts receivable and accounts payable; ~90% of transactions are asset sales with real estate, cash, AR, non-operating assets, and all liabilities stripped. Set ar_ap_excluded = true on ingest (consistent with BIZCOMPS; differs from DealStats default).
